en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley, photographed from a wooded hillside. In the foreground are tall dark conifer trees and open fields; in the middle distance lies the town with dense traditional buildings, several factory chimneys, and a prominent tall church spire dominating the skyline. Rolling hills and patchwork farmland stretch into the background under a cloudy sky. In the lower left margin of the card there is a handwritten-style caption.
